text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, an Umamusume of high 
intellect. Her wish is to "connect with 
other Umamusume" through racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has other hidden motives as 
well, but those will likely become clear 
through her future racing activities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an unpredictable future lying ahead, 
the challenge of the Twinkle Series begins 
now!
